high_level_description: The image shows a set of four square tiles arranged side by side on a concrete surface. The tiles feature an intricate black and white pattern that resembles traditional Moroccan or Islamic geometric designs. Each tile is decorated with a repeating motif consisting of pointed arches and decorative elements that create a symmetrical and visually appealing design. The tiles appear to be made of ceramic or porcelain, given their glossy finish and the way they reflect light. The setting appears to be outdoors, as indicated by the concrete ground beneath the tiles.
